paper_id: Trust-based Service Recommendation in Social Network
title: Trust-based Service Recommendation in Social Network
motivation: Web服务数量激增导致用户难以找到合适服务，现有推荐系统不考虑用户间的信任关系
problem_framing: 结合用户历史调用行为、信任关系和评论来构建特征向量进行服务推荐
key_insight: 通过信任网络扩展用户偏好向量，结合自身和信任用户的调用历史解决冷启动问题
method_signature: 基于信任网络的服务推荐：构建用户特征向量→计算相似度→计算候选服务排名→Top-K推荐
evaluation_criteria: 召回率、准确率、F-measure、排名分数
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 当μ=1时排名分数最低，说明信任关系权重过大会降低推荐质量
evidence_for_taste: they failed to solve the cold start problem
the trust relationships between users are considered, the proposed method can partly solve the cold start problem
the environment factor and user-input factor can hardly represent users subjective opinions
The smaller the value of sim, the more similar
thinking_moves: 将信任问题形式化为用户特征向量的扩展融合
从具体场景示例（Tom/Merry/Bob/Jack）提炼出信任关系的必要性
通过参数μ调节自身偏好与信任用户偏好的权重平衡
cites_own_work: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering 2014
Journal of Computer Science and Technology 2014
